purpose: A posting written in Spanish (Requisitos / Valoramos / Ofrecemos), with alternatives (Python o R; BigQuery o Snowflake; Power BI o Looker), an equivalence clause on the degree, years of experience and a two-language bullet. The CV is Lucía's, rendered to a single-column PDF with accented characters in the text layer (cv.html -> cv.pdf -> cv.txt by scripts/eval/pdf.ts).

requirements.why: POSTING COUNT: seven bullets under Requisitos; the SQL-plus-warehouse and Spanish-plus-English bullets may each be split.
Alternatives inside one bullet are not requirements of their own.
